item.title: [Lanka Talks] Tea export volumes fall through August as dollar prices weaken
item.description: Sri Lanka's tea exports fell 3.7% to 22.82 Mn kg in August and 4.7% to 166.32 Mn kg in Jan-Aug 2026, with higher rupee prices failing to offset lower volumes, Customs data shows. Earnings slipped to Rs 305.7 Bn as bulk tea and tea packets declined, while only instant tea posted growth.
